verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a versioning policy: a new endpoint version is released for every backwards-incompatible change, and versioned endpoints (v2, v3) appear in the API reference. The pack has no documented deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, deprecation notices or support windows for older versions. That covers only about half the story. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy and timelines, deprecation headers or notices, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: A new version of an API endpoint is released whenever a new *backwards incompatible* change is released.
